name: plan creation: organise SRA fastq into tagged collections with the right datatype
description: MODEL-KNOWLEDGE PROBE, EXPECTED TO FAIL ON SMALL MODELS. Read its verdict as a score for the model under test, not as a defect to fix. From an admin request: 20 fastq.gz files from SRA land in a history and need grouping into collections, tagging, and the datatype corrected to fastqsanger.gz. Nothing is executed -- the prompt forbids it -- so the assertions are on the plan. What is under test is whether the agent knows the work: that .gz reads pair into a list:paired collection, that the datatype is fastqsanger.gz rather than the generic fastq, and that tags are set rather than encoded in dataset names. js2-gpt-oss-120b writes `fastqsanger` and hedges with 'or fastq depending on the server's default', which is the error this catches. An earlier description said neither runtime could execute this work; that is no longer true -- organize_datasets does exactly these calls, and the feature itself is graded against Galaxy state by collection-from-paired-reads. Keep the two apart: this one measures what the model knows, that one measures whether the feature works.
inputs: I have 20 fastq.gz files from SRA sitting loose in my current history, paired-end so 10 samples, named like SRR000001_1.fastq.gz and SRR000001_2.fastq.gz. Draft a plan to group them into a collection, tag them, and make sure the datatype is right. Don't execute anything yet.
